Discover well-rated board games that suit your group

find_games.Rd

Keeps the games that your group can play; games that allow your number of players, fit in the time you have, and (optionally) suit your youngest player. The matches are ranked from highest to lowest rating, so the top rows are the best options for your game night.

Usage

find_games(
  players,
  max_minutes,
  youngest_age = NULL,
  min_ratings = 1000,
  cooperative_only = FALSE,
  data = gamenight::games
)

Arguments

players

Number of people playing.

max_minutes

The most time you have, in minutes. Games with a typical playing time longer than this are excluded.

youngest_age

Age of the youngest player, in years. Games whose suggested minimum age is higher are excluded, as are games with no recorded age. Use NULL (the default) to ignore age.

min_ratings

Minimum number of BoardGameGeek ratings a game needs. Ratings based on only a few people are less trustworthy, so raising this leaves fewer but more reliably rated games.

cooperative_only

If TRUE, only keep games where players work together rather than compete.

data

A data frame with the same columns as games. Defaults to the data included in this package.

Value

A data frame with one row per matching game, highest rating first. It has zero rows if no games match.

Examples

# The best games for four players with an hour to spare
find_games(players = 4, max_minutes = 60)
#> # A tibble: 1,545 × 12
#>        id name          year min_players max_players playing_time min_age rating
#>     <int> <chr>        <int>       <int>       <int>        <int>   <int>  <dbl>
#>  1 161936 Pandemic Le…  2015           2           4           60      13   8.44
#>  2 221107 Pandemic Le…  2017           2           4           60      14   7.78
#>  3 284083 The Crew: T…  2019           2           5           20      10   7.78
#>  4 230802 Azul          2017           2           4           45       8   7.69
#>  5 244521 The Quacks …  2018           2           4           45      10   7.68
#>  6    521 Crokinole     1876           2           4           30       8   7.67
#>  7 191189 Aeon's End    2016           1           4           60      14   7.67
#>  8  28143 Race for th…  2007           2           4           60      12   7.65
#>  9 201808 Clank!: A D…  2016           2           4           60      12   7.65
#> 10  68448 7 Wonders     2010           2           7           30      10   7.63
#> # ℹ 1,535 more rows
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: average_rating <dbl>, users_rated <int>,
#> #   cooperative <lgl>, url <chr>

# Two players, half an hour, and an eight-year-old joining in
find_games(players = 2, max_minutes = 30, youngest_age = 8)

# Large groups with little time leave very few options
find_games(players = 8, max_minutes = 30, youngest_age = 6)
